subject: Kickoff: summary report optimization for attribution reporting
body:
Hi Daniela, team,

Kicking off the attribution-reporting optimization work, based on our open-source release on summary report optimization in the privacy-sandbox attribution API.

The problem in plain terms: advertisers query aggregate values over slices of conversion data under a privacy budget, and the way you allocate that budget across slices and value columns changes the error a lot. The codebase optimizes exactly that, scoring with RMSRE-tau error metrics over train/test dataframes.

Product framing: a budget-allocation recommender that our measurement partners run before they configure a campaign.

Milestones: synthetic dataset regeneration and baseline metrics by early May, real-slice study in June, readout the week of July 20.

Dmitri
